saved mask comes from the C5 script as patched in C6, which maps dates to month/day day-of-year. Per-cell hazen 90th-percentile thresholds are computed from ±5-day pools over 1992–2002 and smoothed with a 31-day circular mean. Only smoothed days 153–244 are used, which draw on pool days 138–259, i.e. May 12–Sep 20 of each baseline year. The 2004-06-01..08-31 SST is compared against these thresholds for every sea cell; hot runs are found and merged, and the result is written to output/mhw_mask.nc."}
